download.question: What is Electronic Aadhaar (e-Aadhaar)?
download.description: e-Aadhaar is a digitally signed, password-protected PDF version of your Aadhaar card that carries the same validity as the physical Aadhaar card and can be downloaded online.

download.question: What is the password to open my downloaded e-Aadhaar?
download.description: The password is a combination of the first 4 letters of your name in CAPITAL letters followed by your year of birth in YYYY format, for example RAJE1990.

download.question: Can I download Aadhaar using my Enrolment ID (EID)?
download.description: Yes, you can download your e-Aadhaar using either your 12-digit Aadhaar number or your 28-digit Enrolment ID along with OTP verification on your registered mobile number.

download.question: What if I don't receive the OTP while downloading Aadhaar?
download.description: Check that your mobile number is correctly registered with UIDAI, ensure good network connectivity, and try resending the OTP after the cooldown period.

download.question: Is e-Aadhaar valid as a proof of identity everywhere?
download.description: Yes, e-Aadhaar is a valid, digitally signed electronic document and is accepted as identity and address proof at par with the physical Aadhaar card.

download.question: Can I download Aadhaar without a registered mobile number?
download.description: No, an OTP sent to your registered mobile number is mandatory to download e-Aadhaar. If not registered, update it at an Aadhaar centre first.

download.question: How many times can I download my e-Aadhaar?
download.description: There is no limit on the number of times you can download your e-Aadhaar as long as OTP verification succeeds each time.

download.question: What should I do if my downloaded e-Aadhaar PDF is corrupted?
download.description: Try downloading again with a stable internet connection, or clear your browser cache and use a different browser or device.

retrieve_uid.question: What is UID/EID and where do I find it?
retrieve_uid.description: UID (Aadhaar Number) is the 12-digit number printed on your Aadhaar card. EID (Enrolment ID) is the 28-digit number on your enrolment slip.

retrieve_uid.question: I have lost my Aadhaar card and don't remember my Aadhaar number. What should I do?
retrieve_uid.description: You can retrieve your lost or forgotten Aadhaar number using this service by entering your registered name, date of birth, and mobile number or email.

retrieve_uid.question: Which mobile number or email should I enter here?
retrieve_uid.description: Enter the same mobile number or email address that was registered with UIDAI at the time of Aadhaar enrolment or the most recent update.

retrieve_uid.question: What if my mobile number is not registered with Aadhaar?
retrieve_uid.description: This online service will not work without a registered mobile number. Visit the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra to update it first.

retrieve_uid.question: Is there any fee for retrieving my Aadhaar number or Enrolment ID?
retrieve_uid.description: No, retrieving your Aadhaar number or Enrolment ID through the official UIDAI portal is completely free of cost.

retrieve_uid.question: How many times can I request an OTP for verification?
retrieve_uid.description: There is a limit on OTP requests within a given time frame to prevent misuse. Wait before requesting a new one if the limit is hit.

retrieve_uid.question: Will I get my full Aadhaar number or a masked version?
retrieve_uid.description: After successful OTP verification, your full Aadhaar number or Enrolment ID is sent to your registered mobile number or email.

retrieve_uid.question: Can someone else retrieve my Aadhaar number on my behalf?
retrieve_uid.description: No, retrieval requires OTP verification sent only to your own registered mobile number or email.

retrieve_uid.question: What details are required to retrieve my UID/EID?
retrieve_uid.description: Your full name as per Aadhaar, date of birth, and either registered mobile number or email address along with captcha.

verify_contact.question: Why should I verify my mobile number/email linked to Aadhaar?
verify_contact.description: It confirms whether your current contact details match the ones registered with UIDAI, essential for OTP-based services.

verify_contact.question: What happens if the verification fails?
verify_contact.description: It means the entered mobile number or email doesn't match UIDAI records, and you'll need to update it at an Aadhaar centre.

verify_contact.question: Can I verify both mobile number and email at the same time?
verify_contact.description: Yes, the portal allows checking verification status of both mobile number and email in the same session.

verify_contact.question: Is there a fee for verifying my contact details?
verify_contact.description: No, verifying your registered mobile number or email is a completely free UIDAI service.

verify_contact.question: How often should I verify my registered contact details?
verify_contact.description: Verify whenever you change your mobile number or email, or periodically to ensure your Aadhaar record stays current.

verify_contact.question: What if I no longer have access to my registered mobile number?
verify_contact.description: Update it as soon as possible by visiting an Aadhaar Seva Kendra with valid identity proof.

verify_contact.question: Does this service show my actual mobile number or email?
verify_contact.description: No, it only confirms a match for privacy reasons; it never displays your actual registered details.

report_death.question: Who can report the death of an Aadhaar holder?
report_death.description: A family member, legal heir, registered informant, or authorized government official can report the death for deactivation.

report_death.question: What documents are required to report a death?
report_death.description: A valid death certificate from the competent authority, the deceased's Aadhaar number, and the informant's identity proof.

report_death.question: What happens after a death is reported?
report_death.description: Once verified, UIDAI deactivates the deceased's Aadhaar to prevent misuse and marks the record accordingly.

report_death.question: Can Aadhaar deactivation be reversed by mistake?
report_death.description: Deactivation happens only after due verification; errors can be corrected by contacting UIDAI with supporting documents.

report_death.question: Is there a deadline to report the death of an Aadhaar holder?
report_death.description: No strict penalty for delay, but early reporting is recommended to prevent identity misuse.

report_death.question: Is there a fee for reporting the death of a family member?
report_death.description: No, reporting a death for Aadhaar deactivation is a free UIDAI service.

report_death.question: Can this be done fully online or do I need to visit a centre?
report_death.description: Initial reporting can often be done online, but submitting the original death certificate may need a centre visit or CRS linkage.

doc_update.question: Which documents are accepted as Proof of Identity (PoI)?
doc_update.description: Passport, PAN card, Voter ID, Driving License, and other government-issued photo ID cards.

doc_update.question: Which documents are accepted as Proof of Address (PoA)?
doc_update.description: Utility bills, bank statements, rent agreements, passport, and voter ID are commonly accepted for address updates.

doc_update.question: What file formats are supported for document upload?
doc_update.description: Documents are usually accepted in JPEG, PNG, or PDF format, within a specified maximum file size.

doc_update.question: How long does it take to process a document update?
doc_update.description: Typically a few days to a couple of weeks, depending on verification requirements and request volume.

doc_update.question: Is there a fee for updating documents in Aadhaar?
doc_update.description: Yes, UIDAI charges a nominal fee for demographic updates, varying slightly by mode of update.

doc_update.question: Can I update multiple documents in a single request?
doc_update.description: Yes, multiple supporting documents can be uploaded together if related to the same set of changes.

doc_update.question: What if my document update request gets rejected?
doc_update.description: UIDAI usually provides a reason; you can resubmit with the correct or clearer document.

doc_update.question: How can I check the status of my document update request?
doc_update.description: Track it on the UIDAI portal using the Update Request Number (URN) generated at submission.

vid_generator.question: What is a Virtual ID (VID)?
vid_generator.description: A temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar, usable instead of your Aadhaar number for authentication.

vid_generator.question: Why should I use a VID instead of my Aadhaar number?
vid_generator.description: It adds privacy since it doesn't reveal your actual Aadhaar number to the service provider during authentication.

vid_generator.question: How long is a Virtual ID valid?
vid_generator.description: A VID stays valid for a minimum period set by UIDAI, after which it expires and a new one can be generated.

vid_generator.question: Can I generate a VID without a registered mobile number?
vid_generator.description: No, generating a VID requires OTP verification sent only to your registered mobile number.

vid_generator.question: Can I use my old VID once a new one is generated?
vid_generator.description: No, the previous VID becomes invalid immediately once a new one is generated.

vid_generator.question: Is there a limit on how many times I can generate a VID?
vid_generator.description: Yes, there is a daily limit on VID generation to prevent misuse of the service.

vid_generator.question: Is generating a VID a free service?
vid_generator.description: Yes, generating or retrieving your Virtual ID through the UIDAI portal is completely free.

lock_unlock.question: What happens when I lock my Aadhaar biometrics?
lock_unlock.description: It disables fingerprint and iris-based authentication, protecting you from unauthorized biometric use.

lock_unlock.question: Can I still use Aadhaar for authentication after locking biometrics?
lock_unlock.description: Yes, OTP-based authentication still works even after locking your biometrics.

lock_unlock.question: How do I unlock my Aadhaar biometrics when needed?
lock_unlock.description: Unlock anytime through the UIDAI portal using your Aadhaar number or VID with OTP verification.

lock_unlock.question: Is locking and unlocking Aadhaar biometrics free?
lock_unlock.description: Yes, it is a completely free service provided by UIDAI.

lock_unlock.question: Do I need a registered mobile number to lock/unlock biometrics?
lock_unlock.description: Yes, OTP verification via your registered mobile number is mandatory.

lock_unlock.question: How long does a biometric lock remain active?
lock_unlock.description: It remains active until you manually unlock it; there's no automatic expiry.

lock_unlock.question: Can I temporarily unlock biometrics for a single transaction?
lock_unlock.description: Yes, UIDAI allows temporary unlocking for a limited time, after which it locks again automatically.

lock_unlock.question: Is it safe to keep my Aadhaar biometrics locked permanently?
lock_unlock.description: Yes, it's recommended to keep biometrics locked and unlock only temporarily when genuinely required.

bank_seeding.question: What is Aadhaar Bank Seeding Status?
bank_seeding.description: It shows whether your Aadhaar number is linked (seeded) with your bank account for receiving subsidies and benefits directly.

bank_seeding.question: Why is bank seeding important?
bank_seeding.description: Seeding ensures direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidies, and government payments reach your bank account without delays.

bank_seeding.question: How can I check my Aadhaar bank seeding status?
bank_seeding.description: Enter your Aadhaar number and captcha on the portal, verify via OTP, and view your seeding status instantly.

bank_seeding.question: What if my bank account is not seeded with Aadhaar?
bank_seeding.description: Visit your bank branch or use net banking/mobile banking to link your Aadhaar with your bank account.

bank_seeding.question: Can I seed multiple bank accounts with one Aadhaar?
bank_seeding.description: You can link Aadhaar to multiple accounts, but only one account can be marked as the primary DBT-enabled account.

bank_seeding.question: Is there a fee to check bank seeding status?
bank_seeding.description: No, checking your Aadhaar bank seeding status online is completely free.

bank_seeding.question: How long does bank seeding take to reflect after linking?
bank_seeding.description: It usually takes a few working days for the seeding status to update after linking your Aadhaar with your bank.

pvc_card_status.question: What is an Aadhaar PVC Card?
pvc_card_status.description: It's a durable, credit-card-sized, laminated version of Aadhaar with enhanced security features like a QR code and hologram.

pvc_card_status.question: How can I check my Aadhaar PVC Card order status?
pvc_card_status.description: Enter your Aadhaar number, EID, or SRN (Service Request Number) along with captcha to track your order status.

pvc_card_status.question: What is SRN and where do I find it?
pvc_card_status.description: SRN is the Service Request Number generated when you place a PVC card order, sent to your registered mobile number or email.

pvc_card_status.question: How long does it take to receive the Aadhaar PVC card?
pvc_card_status.description: It typically takes about 5 to 15 working days for delivery via India Post after a successful order.

pvc_card_status.question: What if my PVC card order status shows 'delayed' or 'returned'?
pvc_card_status.description: Check your delivery address for accuracy, and if the card was returned, you may need to reorder with correct details.

pvc_card_status.question: Is there a fee for ordering an Aadhaar PVC Card?
pvc_card_status.description: Yes, UIDAI charges a nominal fee for printing and delivery of the Aadhaar PVC card.

pvc_card_status.question: Can I order a PVC card without a registered mobile number?
pvc_card_status.description: Yes, but you'll need to provide an alternate mobile number for OTP verification during the ordering process.

enrolment_status.question: How can I check my Aadhaar Enrolment or Update status?
enrolment_status.description: Enter your Enrolment ID (EID) along with the date and time of enrolment/update printed on your acknowledgement slip.

enrolment_status.question: How long does it take for Aadhaar enrolment to be processed?
enrolment_status.description: It usually takes 60 to 90 days for a new Aadhaar enrolment or update request to be processed and approved.

enrolment_status.question: What does 'under process' status mean?
enrolment_status.description: It means your enrolment or update request is still being verified by UIDAI and hasn't been finalized yet.

enrolment_status.question: What if my enrolment request gets rejected?
enrolment_status.description: UIDAI will share the reason for rejection; you can visit an enrolment centre again with corrected documents.

enrolment_status.question: Can I check update status without an Enrolment ID?
enrolment_status.description: No, EID along with date and time of the request is mandatory to check enrolment or update status.

enrolment_status.question: Will I get a notification once my update is complete?
enrolment_status.description: Yes, an SMS notification is usually sent to your registered mobile number once the update is processed.

enrolment_status.question: Is checking enrolment status a free service?
enrolment_status.description: Yes, tracking your Aadhaar enrolment or update status online is completely free of charge.

locate_center.question: How can I locate the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra?
locate_center.description: Enter your state, district, or PIN code on the portal to view a list of nearby Aadhaar enrolment and update centres.

locate_center.question: Are all Aadhaar centres open on all days?
locate_center.description: No, working days and hours vary by centre; it's best to check the specific centre's timings before visiting.

locate_center.question: Do I need to book an appointment before visiting a centre?
locate_center.description: Some centres allow walk-ins, but many require prior appointment booking to avoid long waiting times.

locate_center.question: Can I find centres offering specific services like PVC card printing?
locate_center.description: Yes, the locator shows available services at each centre, including biometric update, PVC card, and demographic updates.

locate_center.question: Is locating an Aadhaar centre a free service?
locate_center.description: Yes, searching for nearby Aadhaar Seva Kendras through the official portal is completely free.

locate_center.question: What if there's no Aadhaar centre near my location?
locate_center.description: You can check nearby districts or visit designated bank branches and post offices that also offer Aadhaar services.

locate_center.question: Can I get directions to the Aadhaar centre from the portal?
locate_center.description: Yes, most listings include an address and map link to help you navigate to the nearest centre.

book_appointment.question: How do I book an appointment for Aadhaar enrolment or update?
book_appointment.description: Select your city or Aadhaar Seva Kendra, choose an available date and time slot, and confirm your booking online.

book_appointment.question: Is appointment booking mandatory for all Aadhaar centres?
book_appointment.description: It's mandatory for Aadhaar Seva Kendras (ASKs) but optional for some other enrolment centres that accept walk-ins.

book_appointment.question: Can I reschedule or cancel my booked appointment?
book_appointment.description: Yes, you can reschedule or cancel your appointment online before the scheduled date and time.

book_appointment.question: What should I bring to my Aadhaar appointment?
book_appointment.description: Carry your appointment confirmation slip along with original supporting documents for identity and address proof.

book_appointment.question: Is there a fee for booking an appointment?
book_appointment.description: No, booking the appointment itself is free; charges apply only for the actual enrolment or update service.

book_appointment.question: What happens if I miss my scheduled appointment?
book_appointment.description: You will need to book a new appointment slot, as missed appointments are not automatically rescheduled.

book_appointment.question: How early should I arrive for my appointment?
book_appointment.description: It's recommended to arrive at least 10-15 minutes before your scheduled slot to complete formalities on time.

check_validity.question: What does 'Check Aadhaar Validity' mean?
check_validity.description: It lets you verify whether your Aadhaar number is currently active, valid, and correctly linked in the UIDAI database.

check_validity.question: How can I check if my Aadhaar is valid?
check_validity.description: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number and captcha on the portal to instantly view its validity status.

check_validity.question: Why would my Aadhaar show as invalid or inactive?
check_validity.description: This can happen due to deactivation after death reporting, duplicate Aadhaar cancellation, or data discrepancies.

check_validity.question: What should I do if my Aadhaar shows invalid status?
check_validity.description: Visit the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra with your identity documents to resolve the issue and reactivate if eligible.

check_validity.question: Is checking Aadhaar validity a free service?
check_validity.description: Yes, verifying your Aadhaar validity status online is completely free of cost.

check_validity.question: Does this service reveal my personal Aadhaar details?
check_validity.description: No, it only confirms the active/inactive status without displaying sensitive personal information.

check_validity.question: Can I check someone else's Aadhaar validity?
check_validity.description: You can check validity using just the Aadhaar number, but sensitive personal details remain protected regardless.

grievance_feedback.question: How can I file a grievance or feedback regarding Aadhaar services?
grievance_feedback.description: Fill out the online grievance form with your contact details, category of issue, and a description of your complaint.

grievance_feedback.question: What type of issues can I report through this service?
grievance_feedback.description: You can report enrolment issues, update delays, biometric problems, centre-related complaints, or general feedback.

grievance_feedback.question: Do I need my Aadhaar number to file a grievance?
grievance_feedback.description: It's recommended but not always mandatory; some general feedback categories don't require an Aadhaar number.

grievance_feedback.question: How long does it take to resolve a grievance?
grievance_feedback.description: Resolution time varies by complaint type, typically ranging from a few days to a few weeks.

grievance_feedback.question: Will I receive a reference number after filing a grievance?
grievance_feedback.description: Yes, a unique grievance/reference number is generated which you can use to track the status later.

grievance_feedback.question: Is filing a grievance or feedback free of cost?
grievance_feedback.description: Yes, submitting grievances or feedback through the official UIDAI portal is completely free.

grievance_feedback.question: Can I attach supporting documents with my grievance?
grievance_feedback.description: Yes, the form typically allows you to upload relevant documents or screenshots to support your complaint.

grievance_status.question: How can I check the status of my filed grievance?
grievance_status.description: Enter your grievance reference number (SRN) on the portal to view its current status and any updates.

grievance_status.question: What if I lost my grievance reference number?
grievance_status.description: Check your email or SMS confirmation received at the time of filing, as it usually contains the reference number.

grievance_status.question: What does 'in progress' status mean for my grievance?
grievance_status.description: It means your complaint has been received and is currently being reviewed or resolved by the concerned department.

grievance_status.question: How will I be notified once my grievance is resolved?
grievance_status.description: You'll typically receive an SMS or email notification to your registered contact details once it's resolved.

grievance_status.question: What should I do if my grievance status hasn't changed for a long time?
grievance_status.description: You can follow up by raising a reminder or escalation through the same portal referencing your original SRN.

grievance_status.question: Is checking grievance status a free service?
grievance_status.description: Yes, tracking the status of your filed grievance online is completely free of charge.

grievance_status.question: Can I reopen a grievance if I'm not satisfied with the resolution?
grievance_status.description: Yes, most portals allow you to reopen or escalate a grievance if the resolution provided isn't satisfactory.
